title: useOutletContext
summary: Read a typed value supplied by an ancestor Outlet.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no runtime arguments. Specify the context shape as its type argument; TypeScript cannot infer a provider’s type across the component tree.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns the nearest Outlet context cast to T. There is no runtime validation. Without a provider the value is undefined, so include undefined in T when a missing provider is an expected state.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Define the context contract once and import it in the layout and its children.

sections.title: Inheritance
sections.body: Outlet inherits its ancestor context when its context prop is null or undefined. This is component context, not a second loader store. Keep server data in loaders and pass only the view contract needed by descendants.
